parsed_response.reasoning: The diff does remove the guard: `expandable_first_post?` changes from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to just `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?`. There is no replacement global check (the new EmbeddableHost model is never consulted there), and the retained spec 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' indeed no longer sets anything blank — it passes vacuously since an unstubbbed Fabricate.build(:topic) has no topic embed. This is a real, specific behavior change: with all hosts deleted, previously-embedded topics still render expandable/truncated first posts, losing the old decommission kill switch. Whether it is a defect is debatable (arguably intended, since per-host categories replaced the global setting), but the substantive loss of the gate plus the now-meaningless test is a legitimate non-bug review concern grounded in the cited diff lines.

judged_text: expandable_first_post? drops the `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` guard, so the invariant 'no expandable first post unless embedding is configured' is no longer enforced. An admin who deletes all embeddable hosts to decommission embedding loses the global kill switch the old setting provided — previously-embedded topics keep rendering truncated expandable first posts — and the retained spec named 'is false if embeddable_host is blank' no longer sets anything blank, so it passes while verifying nothing about the removed gate.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `Topic#expandable_first_post?` from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to only `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb), while the `embeddable_hosts` site setting is removed elsewhere. This means expandable/truncated first posts can remain enabled for already-embedded topics even when there are zero `EmbeddableHost` records (i.e., embedding effectively decommissioned). The updated spec `"is false if embeddable_host is blank"` no longer blanks anything and will pass merely because `SiteSetting.embed_truncate` defaults to false, so it no longer verifies the old gate (spec/models/topic_spec.rb).
